title: Maritime gathering and refreshments

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Give leisure a specific setting so a scene can evoke the city through its activities and landmarks.
strategic_value: Waterfront seating, a canopy, sculpture and kiosk can make Helsinki’s leisure imagery locally distinctive.
demonstration: A white tent, terraces, a floating pool-like scene, a fountain, fish seller, birds and an ice-cream vendor sit on green.
practical_value: Combine a setting element with a small number of leisure figures to establish a waterfront theme.

content_islands.spec: Place the tent, terrace and blue water structure across the top and middle.
